summary: Owned units s0023–s0044 contain no birth, death, or age statements; the dated material is Yin Hao’s Yangzhou letter and later northern campaign, Wang Dao’s earlier recruitment recalled as 王丞相時, Ma Midi’s Han-end embassy cited as a precedent, Shang Ziping invoked as a model of withdrawal, Huan Wen named only as Yin Hao’s rival, and Yao Xiang as the victor at Shansang. The 346 lower bound for Yin Hao as Inspector of Yang, the 352–353 window for his campaign–defeat sequence, the 192 dispatch of Ma Midi, the 317–339 conventional span of Wang Dao as 王丞相, the on-or-before 353 bound on Wang Xizhi’s concord letter, Yao Xiang’s 353 victory, and the undated retrospective Shang Ziping citation are supported from the Chinese plus Jin Shu annals, Hou Han Shu, and Zizhi Tongjian year labels. Huan Wen’s 不協 is not a 352–353 event: Jin Shu’s Yin Hao biography places the rivalry after the Shu conquest, and s0035 only attests contemporary discord when Wang wrote. The AD 352–353 hint for p017 therefore cannot stand.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi wrote urging concord between Yin Hao and Huan Wen, then tried to stop the northern expedition that ended in Yao Xiang’s defeat.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event belongs to Wang Xizhi: after the Kuaiji posting in s0034, s0035 has him write because 殷浩與桓溫不協, s0036–s0038 place that advice before 浩將北伐 and 果為姚襄所敗. The chapter does not date the Kuaiji appointment, which the claim correctly leaves undated. Jin Shu 8 and Tongjian date the Shansang defeat to 永和九年冬十月; Tongjian labels that year 公元三五三年. Month 10 sits well after New Year, so the Western year stays AD 353 in both Julian and proleptic Gregorian. The concord letter precedes that defeat and may still fall in 353, so onOrBefore 353 is the justified upper bound. No second endpoint is invented.

evidence.quote: 時殷浩與桓溫不協，羲之以國家之安在於內外和，因以與浩書以戒之
及浩將北伐，羲之以為必敗，以書止之
浩遂行果為姚襄所敗

itemChecks.event: While Chancellor, Wang Dao tried to bring Wang Xizhi into the administration.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event belongs to Wang Dao: s0029 recalls 王丞相時果欲內吾, an undated recruitment during his chancellorship. Jin Shu 65 begins that ministerial dominance at 晉國既建 (Tongjian 建武元年, 公元三一七年), when he was 丞相軍諮祭酒 and then 錄尚書事; Jin Shu 7 records his death 咸康五年秋七月庚申 (Tongjian 公元三三九年). The 317–339 interval is uncertainty about when the single recruitment occurred inside the conventional 王丞相 period, not a claim that the attempt lasted twenty-two years. A competing official-title reading exists—Jin Shu 7 first 拜丞相 in 咸康四年—but 王丞相時 in this letter names Wang Dao’s era as chief minister, not only the 338–339 title, so the wider window is retained.

evidence.quote: 直王丞相時果欲內吾，誓不許之

itemChecks.event: As Inspector of Yang, Yin Hao wrote urging Wang Xizhi to accept the Guards’ General appointment.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event belongs to Yin Hao. s0024 names him 揚州刺史 and has him write after s0023’s still-unaccepted 護軍 offer. Jin Shu 8 dates the first appointment 永和二年三月丙子; his biography says he declined 自三月至七月，乃受拜焉, still inside that year. Tongjian labels 永和二年 公元三四六年. The letter is written while he already holds the office, so it can fall in 346: onOrAfter 346, not after 346. No later endpoint is invented, even though he later left in mourning and was reappointed.

evidence.quote: 揚州刺史殷浩素雅重之，勸使應命

itemChecks.event: Grand Tutor Ma Midi was sent to console and pacify the lands east of the passes.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event belongs to Ma Midi, not to Wang Xizhi’s later citation. s0033’s 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東 is the well-known late-Han embassy. Hou Han Shu 9 records, under 初平三年, 八月，遣日磾及太僕趙歧，持節慰撫天下; Tongjian 60 restates 杖節鎮撫關東 and labels 初平三年 公元一九二年. The dispatch is in month 8, not near New Year, so the Western year remains AD 192 in Julian or proleptic Gregorian. Year 192 dates the sending, not Ma Midi’s later death at Shouchun.

evidence.quote: 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東

itemChecks.event: Huan Wen was at odds with Yin Hao when Wang Xizhi wrote about their discord.
itemChecks.reason: The owner of any date here is Huan Wen, but s0035 only attests 時殷浩與桓溫不協 as background to Wang’s letter. That 時 is the narrative present after the Kuaiji posting; it does not supply 352 or 353. The closed interval copies Yin Hao’s campaign years. Jin Shu’s Yin Hao biography places 與溫頗相疑貳 after Huan Wen destroyed Shu, well before 永和八年, and Huan Wen’s memorial dismissing Yin Hao belongs to 永和十年. 352–353 is therefore neither the span of the rivalry nor honest uncertainty about one Huan Wen action. Endpoints cannot be taken from another man’s northern expedition.

evidence.quote: 時殷浩與桓溫不協

itemChecks.event: Yao Xiang defeated Yin Hao’s northern army.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event belongs to Yao Xiang: s0037 果為姚襄所敗 is his victory, not a later commemoration. Jin Shu 8 records 永和九年冬十月…使平北將軍姚襄為前鋒，襄叛，反撃浩. Tongjian labels 永和九年 公元三五三年. The same chapter’s 永和九年暮春 Lanting date shows month 3 already in AD 353, so month 10 remains AD 353 under Julian or proleptic Gregorian and is not a New Year boundary case. Conventional 永和九年 therefore supports westernYear 353 at year precision.

evidence.quote: 浩遂行果為姚襄所敗

itemChecks.event: Yin Hao ignored Wang Xizhi’s warning, campaigned north, and was defeated by Yao Xiang.
itemChecks.reason: The dated cluster belongs to Yin Hao. s0035–s0038 give the warning, the march, 果為姚襄所敗, and 復圖再舉. Jin Shu 8 dates a first northern move 永和八年…殷浩帥衆北伐，次泗口, and the Yao Xiang defeat 永和九年冬十月. Tongjian, under 永和八年（公元三五二年）, says 殷浩之北伐也，中軍將軍王羲之以書止之, then under 永和九年（公元三五三年） narrates the Shansang rout. Those two years are Yin Hao’s own campaign endpoints, not a dynasty-long activity window. 不協 itself began earlier after the Shu conquest, but it is only background; the interval is justified by the warning–campaign–defeat sequence. 再舉 sits after month 10 of 353 and before the 永和十年 dismissal, still AD 353 at year precision.

evidence.quote: 時殷浩與桓溫不協
及浩將北伐，羲之以為必敗，以書止之，言甚切至
浩遂行果為姚襄所敗
復圖再舉，又遺浩書曰

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi cites Shang Ziping’s withdrawal as the model ambition he has nursed since his children married.
itemChecks.reason: s0030 is a later reception, not Shang Ziping’s own dated life event: 便懷尚子平之志. The retrospective-reference / receptionType retrospective classification is correct. The reply itself is undated in the chapter, and the claim invents no life year or active hint. This is not a posthumous subtype and does not require proof that Shang Ziping was already dead.

evidence.quote: 自兒娶女嫁，便懷尚子平之志

itemChecks.event: Yin Hao holds Yang province from AD 346 and conducts the northern campaigns of AD 352-353.
itemChecks.reason: The hints track Yin Hao’s own supported events: first becoming 揚州刺史 in 永和二年 / AD 346, which bounds the s0024 letter (on or after 346), and the 352–353 campaign–defeat sequence in claim-957. They are not reception dates and do not turn the 346 bound into a second invented endpoint on the letter itself.

evidence.quote: 揚州刺史殷浩素雅重之，勸使應命
浩遂行果為姚襄所敗

itemChecks.event: The empty hint list is correct: the chapter only cites Shang Ziping retrospectively and attests no dated event of his own.
itemChecks.reason: s0030 is reception only. An empty active-hint array correctly keeps that later reference from feeding life dates or living activity.

evidence.quote: 便懷尚子平之志，數與親知言之，非一日也

itemChecks.event: Ma Midi was sent on the AD 192 consolation mission east of the passes.
itemChecks.reason: The AD 192 hint is Ma Midi’s own embassy dated from 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東 via Hou Han Shu / Tongjian 初平三年, not the date of Wang Xizhi’s later citation.

evidence.quote: 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東

itemChecks.event: The hint assigns AD 352-353 to Huan Wen, but the chapter only attests that he was at odds with Yin Hao and does not date that rivalry to those campaign years.
itemChecks.reason: Active hints must follow supported personal events. Huan Wen’s only appearance in the owned units is 桓溫不協. That state is not bounded to 352–353, so the hint imports Yin Hao’s campaign window as if it were Huan Wen’s activity.

evidence.quote: 時殷浩與桓溫不協

itemChecks.event: Yao Xiang defeated Yin Hao in AD 353.
itemChecks.reason: The hint matches Yao Xiang’s own supported victory in s0037, converted from 永和九年冬十月 as AD 353.

evidence.quote: 果為姚襄所敗

personChecks.reason: Yin Hao’s owned items cohere: the s0024 letter as 揚州刺史 cannot precede the 永和二年 / AD 346 appointment, and s0035–s0038 plus the annals give his own warning–campaign–defeat sequence in 352–353. s0058 (context) only continues the same northern-war aftermath and does not move those life dates. Owned units record no birth, death, or age for him; none is supplied from later exile material.

evidence.quote: 揚州刺史殷浩素雅重之
及浩將北伐
浩遂行果為姚襄所敗

personChecks.reason: The chapter never dates Shang Ziping’s own life. The only mention is Wang Xizhi’s undated 尚子平之志, correctly stored as retrospective reception with empty hints. No birth, death, or age appears in the owned units, and 同生 is not in play.

evidence.quote: 自兒娶女嫁，便懷尚子平之志

personChecks.reason: Ma Midi’s only owned chronology is the embassy Wang cites. Dating that dispatch to AD 192 uses Ma Midi’s own mission, not the letter’s composition date. Owned units give no birth, death, or age; the later death at Shouchun is outside this audit.

evidence.quote: 漢末使太傅馬日磾慰撫關東

personChecks.reason: Huan Wen’s only owned dated claim and hint treat 不協 as a 352–353 interval. The Chinese attests him solely as the other party to Yin Hao’s discord; Jin Shu’s Yin Hao biography starts that rivalry after the Shu conquest, and nothing in s0035–s0038 is Huan Wen’s own 352–353 action. Using Yin Hao’s campaign years as Huan Wen’s life or activity dates is unsupported. Owned units have no birth, death, or age for him.

evidence.quote: 時殷浩與桓溫不協

personChecks.reason: Yao Xiang’s only owned event is the Shansang victory in s0037, which the Mu-di annals fix to 永和九年冬十月 / AD 353. That is his own battle, not later reception. Owned units record no birth, death, or age, and none is imported from his later death.

evidence.quote: 浩遂行果為姚襄所敗

findings.problem: claim-171 and the p017 AD 352-353 hint date Huan Wen’s being at odds from Yin Hao’s northern-campaign years. s0035 only says 時殷浩與桓溫不協 when Wang Xizhi wrote; Jin Shu’s Yin Hao biography places 與溫頗相疑貳 after Huan Wen destroyed Shu, and Yin Hao’s dismissal is 永和十年. The closed 352-353 interval is not Huan Wen’s own event and must not feed his activity dates.
findings.action: Replace claim-171’s westernInterval 352-353 with a bound that dates only the attested moment of discord, such as onOrBefore AD 353, or onOrAfter 348 and onOrBefore 354 if the post-Shu start is kept as a competing reading. Do not invent an exact year. Clear p017’s AD 352-353 active hint so it no longer copies Yin Hao’s campaign window.
